decision_conditions:
<p>The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three
years from the date of this permission.&nbsp;</p>

<p>The residential element of the development hereby permitted shall be used for 
Class C3 dwellinghouse(s) only and notwithstanding the provisions of the Town 
and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 
(or any Order revoking or re-enacting that Order with or without modification), no 
development within Schedule 2, Part 3, Class L shall take place.</p>

<p>The dwellinghouses hereby approved shall not be first until the bin store has 
been provided in accordance with the details so agreed. Other than on collection 
days, all waste and recycling containers associated with the occupation of the 
approved development shall be stored within the agreed bin store</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved details, the development hereby permitted shall 
not be first occupied until the following details have been submitted and 
approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority: 
a) Secured, sheltered and accessible cycle storage for the provision of 8 long
stay bikes and 2 short-stay bikes.   
The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details 
and shall thereafter be retained.&nbsp;</p>
description: Erection of additional storey to provide 4 new self-contained flats; works to the existing two-storey apartment to convert into two self-contained apartments; new front entrance; new facing brick finish to front facade; replacement windows; external alterations.
